name: Piecewise Quadratic Hermite Interpolation
definition: A method to interpolate the normalized field $g \circ f \circ r^{-1}$ within a subinterval using two piecewise quadratic Bézier curves to respect Hermite data (value and derivative) at both endpoints, avoiding the incompatibility of single quadratic interpolation with four constraints.
summary: Piecewise Quadratic Hermite Interpolation splits an interval into two quadratic Bézier segments to satisfy endpoint values and derivatives, offering better stability and efficiency than cubic interpolation.
